name: Star Jump
steps: Stand with your feet close together, drop into a compact quarter squat, and tuck your arms close in front of your shins or thighs.
Push through both feet to jump, opening your arms and legs into an X while airborne.
Draw your arms and legs swiftly back in before touching down.
Land softly with bent knees back into the starting quarter squat and flow directly into the next repetition.
tips: Absorb every landing smoothly through your ankles, knees, and hips rather than landing stiff-legged.
Brace your core in midair so your lower back does not arch sharply as your limbs spread wide.
